title: Points log table schema and migration
description: Define the points_log table for tracking every points transaction on a project — both automatic (from todos/milestones) and manual adjustments.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
source ENUM covers all point sources
delta can be positive or negative

steps.description: Define point source enum and points_log table
steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/pointsLog.ts. Define pointSourceEnum = pgEnum('point_source', ['todo', 'milestone', 'journal', 'github_commit', 'github_release', 'manual']). Define points_log table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects cascade delete), delta (integer notNull — positive or negative), reason (varchar 255 notNull), source (pointSourceEnum notNull), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on points_log.project_id for efficient aggregation queries.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type PointsLog and type NewPointsLog. Add 'export * from ./pointsLog' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify points_log table with correct columns.

technicalNotes: delta is the change amount — e.g., +10 for completing a todo, -10 for unchecking it
points_total on the projects table is the running sum of all points_log entries for that project
